# Rem character artwork

`classic.png` is the original maid-outfit character illustration from the
official Re:ZERO anime website, downloaded on 2026-10-26.

- Character page: https://re-zero-anime.jp/tv/character/
- Original image: https://re-zero-anime.jp/tv/assets/character/c/4.png

The illustration remains the property of its respective rights holders; the
project does not claim ownership or grant a license to this artwork.
The application crops and scales the original locally, preserving its colours
and transparency. No network access is required at runtime.
